test: E2_prospective_mechanism_test — addendum (forced-deleveraging proxy and analysis plan)
amends: E2_prospective.json (spec hash 74b6a69ffb0c76650c2115bd6d5d979f1debb088c1b45cd723d5b228a85f6e68, registered in commit f76f379, pushed 2026-10-23 00:05 UTC). The original hypotheses, sample of 20 symbols, correction and pass rules are kept; this addendum fixes what the original left undefined.
why: The original measure, liquidation volume from Binance's forced-liquidation stream, cannot be recorded from the United States (the stream returns HTTP 451), and data.binance.vision publishes no liquidation files for USD-M futures, so the registered archive fallback contains no liquidation data. The recorder committed with the original specification fetched only metrics files. This addendum therefore (i) replaces liquidation volume by a forced-deleveraging proxy built from open interest, (ii) fixes the dates, the training/test split and the estimators. It is pushed in a commit of its own before any file dated after the registration has been downloaded or opened for this test.
consequence: E2 can no longer test the liquidation channel with direct liquidation data, which was its stated advantage over the open-interest proxy of Part 22. Its result is evidence about open interest destroyed during large moves, and will be reported as such.
dates: every date from 2026-10-24 (the first full UTC day after the registration push) to 2027-01-31: 100 dates; training = the first 50 (2026-10-24 to 2026-12-12), test = the last 50 (2026-12-13 to 2027-01-31)
data: data.binance.vision USD-M daily files: 1-minute klines, bookDepth, 5-minute metrics; every file checked against Binance's .CHECKSUM; a symbol-day is valid when validated depth covers at least 80% of minutes (Paper 2 rule)
liquidation_proxy: LIQ(window) = 100 * sum over 5-minute metric marks k in the window of max(0, -(OI_k - OI_{k-1})) * 1{|ret_k| > 2 sd_k} / OI at the window start, with OI = sum_open_interest_value, ret_k the 5-minute log return (bp) between marks and sd_k the standard deviation of the previous 72 five-minute returns; outcomes use log(1 + LIQ)
blocks: hourly blocks 06-23 UTC as in Paper 2 Part 6 (cell Z5): C3_hat from the previous 360 minutes, controls rv_60, rv_360, abs_ret_60, flow_imb_60, log_vol_60, log_depth1, imbalance, oi_chg_60, and impact controls kappa_hat, kappa_hat^2, kyle_lam, amihud_60 (winsorized at training 1%/99%); flow scaled by each symbol's training median |flow|; MAE_60 = maximum absolute log-price excursion over the next 60 minutes
primary_1: Outcome log(1 + LIQ next hour); baseline = controls + impact controls + log(1 + LIQ previous hour) with symbol fixed effects fitted on training blocks; candidate C3_hat (winsorized at training 1%/99%). Passes if the Holm-adjusted one-sided Clark-West p-value (6 lags) is below 0.05 and the 95% date-block bootstrap interval (2000 draws) for out-of-sample Delta R^2 lies above zero.
primary_2: Outcome MAE_60. gain = out-of-sample Delta R^2 of C3_hat over controls + impact controls; gain_LIQ = the same with realized log(1 + LIQ next hour) added to both models; share = 1 - gain_LIQ/gain, all on the same test blocks with fixed training coefficients. Evaluable only if the 95% bootstrap interval of gain lies above zero (otherwise P2 fails). Passes if share >= 0.5, its 95% date-block bootstrap interval lies above zero, and the Holm-adjusted bootstrap p-value (share of draws with share <= 0) is below 0.05.
correction: Holm across P1 and P2 at 0.05 (as registered)
opening_rule: This addendum, its hash and the analysis are committed and pushed in a commit of their own. The original unlock counter E2_unlock.json (opens 0) is used: the analysis refuses to run before 2027-02-02 or with the counter above 0, sets it to 1, downloads the data and evaluates once. Counter, results, numbers and download log are committed together; a failed primary is reported as failed.
